"""由Blender MCP执行的A1样区烘焙：独立UV2、AO与无底色间接光，不替换主场景。"""
import argparse,hashlib,json,math,time
from pathlib import Path
import bpy
from mathutils import Vector

ROOT=Path('__PROJECT_ROOT__')
PLAN=json.loads((ROOT/'planning/project.json').read_text())
CFG=PLAN['production']['bakingPilot']
OUT=ROOT/CFG['outputDirectory'];OUT.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)

def record(stage,**kwargs):
 payload={'stage':stage,'planningSha256':hashlib.sha256((ROOT/'planning/project.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),**kwargs}
 (OUT/'job.json').write_text(json.dumps(payload,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
 print(json.dumps(payload,ensure_ascii=False))

def bake(kind):
 receivers=[bpy.data.objects[n] for n in CFG['receivers']]
 bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
 image=bpy.data.images.new('pilot_'+kind+'_web_final',width=CFG['resolution'],height=CFG['resolution'],float_buffer=True)
 image.colorspace_settings.name='Linear Rec.709'
 for obj in receivers:
  obj.select_set(True)
  for mat in obj.data.materials:
   target=mat.node_tree.nodes.get('BakeTarget') or mat.node_tree.nodes.new('ShaderNodeTexImage');target.name='BakeTarget';target.image=image;mat.node_tree.nodes.active=target
   if kind=='indirect':mat.node_tree.nodes['Principled BSDF'].inputs['Metallic'].default_value=0
 bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active=receivers[0]
 bpy.context.scene.cycles.samples=CFG['aoSamples'] if kind=='ao' else CFG['samples']
 started=time.time();record('baking_'+kind)
 if kind=='ao':
  # AO节点只输出指定距离的遮蔽；以EMIT烘焙该结果，不包含底色或灯光。
  rewired=[]
  for obj in receivers:
   for mat in obj.data.materials:
    nt=mat.node_tree;output=nt.nodes.get('Material Output');old=output.inputs['Surface'].links[0].from_socket
    ao_node=nt.nodes.new('ShaderNodeAmbientOcclusion');ao_node.inputs['Distance'].default_value=CFG['aoDistanceM'];ao_node.samples=16
    emission=nt.nodes.new('ShaderNodeEmission');nt.links.new(ao_node.outputs['AO'],emission.inputs['Color']);nt.links.new(emission.outputs[0],output.inputs['Surface'])
    rewired.append((nt,output,old,ao_node,emission))
  bpy.ops.object.bake(type='EMIT')
  for nt,output,old,ao_node,emission in rewired:
   nt.links.new(old,output.inputs['Surface']);nt.nodes.remove(ao_node);nt.nodes.remove(emission)
 else:bpy.ops.object.bake(type='DIFFUSE',pass_filter={'INDIRECT'})
 if kind=='ao':
  image.filepath_raw=str(OUT/'ao.png');image.file_format='PNG';image.save()
 else:
  image.filepath_raw=str(OUT/'indirect.exr');image.file_format='OPEN_EXR';image.save()
  # 无色彩变换的线性PNG，网页以NoColorSpace读取，不烘入曝光。
  image=bpy.data.images.load(str(OUT/'indirect.exr'),check_existing=False)
  web=CFG['webIndirect'];image.scale(web['resolution'],web['resolution'])
  scene=bpy.context.scene;old=scene.view_settings.view_transform;scene.view_settings.view_transform='Raw';scene.render.image_settings.file_format='PNG';scene.render.image_settings.color_mode='RGB';scene.render.image_settings.color_depth=str(web['bitDepth'])
  image.save_render(str(OUT/'indirect.png'),scene=scene);scene.view_settings.view_transform=old
 for obj in receivers:
  for mat in obj.data.materials:mat.node_tree.nodes['Principled BSDF'].inputs['Metallic'].default_value=mat['originalMetallic']
 bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=str(OUT/('pilot-'+kind+'.blend')))
 record(kind+'_done',seconds=round(time.time()-started,2),file=str(image.filepath_raw))

for name in ['landscape_skin','landscape_clothes']:
 obj=bpy.data.objects.get(name)
 if obj:obj.hide_render=True
obj=bpy.data.objects.get('landscape_stone')
if obj:
 if '_unbaked_people_original' not in bpy.data.meshes:
  original=obj.data;original.name='_unbaked_people_original';obj.data=original.copy()
  positions=[r['positionM'] for i,r in enumerate(PLAN['production']['landscape']['people']) if i%3==0]
  bm=bmesh.new();bm.from_mesh(obj.data)
  faces=[f for f in bm.faces if any(abs(f.calc_center_median().x-x)<.25 and abs(f.calc_center_median().y-y)<.18 and 1.25<f.calc_center_median().z<2.07 for x,y in positions)]
  bmesh.ops.delete(bm,geom=faces,context='FACES');bm.to_mesh(obj.data);bm.free()
  print('STATIC_PEOPLE_SHIRTS_EXCLUDED',len(faces))
